metric_definition.COCO: official pycocotools COCOeval keypoint AP/AR using OKS thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95 and default COCO keypoint sigmas
metric_definition.mean_OKS_single_prediction: per-image OKS using official COCO keypoint sigmas, ground-truth area, and all v>0 joints; no-detection scores 0; averaged over all images in the selected dataset; descriptive companion statistic, not official AP
metric_definition.PCK: percentage of v>0 ground-truth joints whose Euclidean pixel error is <= threshold * max(ground-truth bbox width, height); missing/no-detection predictions count incorrect
metric_definition.normalizer_source: ground-truth annotation bbox, not model-predicted bbox
